construct_validity.definition_plain_english: tennis position / context role + difficulty calibration
construct_validity.operationalization: Model predicts pos_acc 0.797 + difficulty in-band 92.9% — leave-one-competition-out CV; measured via CV MAE/RMSE/R2 + SHAP/permutation importance + glass-box logs
construct_validity.predictive_validity: out-of-sample CV + holdout 80/10/10 split stratified by era/sector (train13/val1/test3 pattern)
construct_validity.modeling_rule_reminder: train real models ≥2, 5-fold CV MAE/RMSE/R2, model-agnostic SHAP/permutation + glass-box log — no heuristics alone
